## Bibliographic checks (data changes)

- [ ] Title, full author list and order, year and venue checked against a primary source (paper, DOI record, publisher or proceedings)
- [ ] Preprint and peer-reviewed versions distinguished; no duplicate records
- [ ] DOI / arXiv / publisher URL recorded

## Evidence checks (data changes)

- [ ] Every new analytical statement has an evidence record (URL, source type, locator, status, access date)
- [ ] Relationships are stated by a source, not inferred from chronology; baseline comparisons are not successors
- [ ] New authors enter only through verified bylines; affiliations are dated and separate from byline verification
- [ ] Missing comparison values use a qualified NA; results keep dataset, split, task, metric and unit
- [ ] Curator interpretation is labelled as such
- [ ] No weekly-discovery candidate added without manual verification

## Validation

- [ ] `pnpm check` passes (validate, typecheck, lint, build)
- [ ] `pnpm counts` run if corpus size changed
- [ ] Affected views checked in the preview deployment (desktop and mobile)
- [ ] No validation rule weakened to make this pass
